fixture_team_stats.ddl: CREATE TABLE fixture_team_stats ( fixture_revision_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES fixture_revisions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, team_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id), shots_total INTEGER CHECK (shots_total IS NULL OR shots_total >= 0), shots_on_goal INTEGER CHECK (shots_on_goal IS NULL OR shots_on_goal >= 0), possession_percent REAL CHECK (possession_percent IS NULL OR (possession_percent >= 0 AND possession_percent <= 100)), passes_total INTEGER CHECK (passes_total IS NULL OR passes_total >= 0), passes_accurate INTEGER CHECK (passes_accurate IS NULL OR passes_accurate >= 0), fouls INTEGER CHECK (fouls IS NULL OR fouls >= 0), corners INTEGER CHECK (corners IS NULL OR corners >= 0), extra_stats_json TEXT CHECK (extra_stats_json IS NULL OR json_valid(extra_stats_json)), PRIMARY KEY (fixture_revision_id, team_id) ) WITHOUT ROWID
